method.description: Attempted public official download of the two Montana MMRTA forms from the Office of the Court Administrator, followed by an in-repository reconciliation of what is already retained for the same two identities. The recorded network block was independently re-tested rather than carried forward as fact, because a recorded block is a claim about one client on one day and has already proved wrong in the opposite direction elsewhere in this programme.
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition requires using only the assigned public official sources, recording provenance and hashes, and stopping if identity, revision or issuer authority is uncertain. Identity and issuer are confirmed and are recorded. Revision is uncertain and could not be made certain, so the job stops there rather than substituting a mirror, an archived capture or a filename date for a revision.

retrievalOutcome.distinctFromAWafBlock: This is not an HTTP 403, a bot challenge or a WAF rejection. No HTTP response was received at all — the connection itself did not complete. A 403 tells you the server saw the request and refused it; this tells you nothing reached a server.

retrievalOutcome.reconfirmationValue: The recorded position was tested, not assumed. It holds unchanged five days later across three hostnames. Recording it as reconfirmed is what distinguishes it from the Arizona case in an earlier wave, where a recorded total block proved to be a client-side artefact and the host answered every request with HTTP 200.
whatWasNotDone: No mirror, aggregator or county reproduction was retrieved in place of the issuer.

No archived capture was promoted to a current source. The acquisition intelligence's own evidence for these rows is an archived capture, and an archived capture establishes what a page said once, not what the issuer publishes today.
No user agent was spoofed beyond an ordinary browser string, and there was nothing to spoof against.
No alternative route the issuer does not offer was attempted.

acquisitionDisposition.acquisitionRequiredRationale: Unlike most identities resolved in this programme, these two genuinely do need an issuer retrieval. The edition retains bytes for both, but their revision is unknown, their titles are filename stems, and their currentness has never been confirmed against the issuer. Only the issuer can close that.
acquisitionDisposition.acquisitionBlockedByDetail: courts.mt.gov did not resolve or accept a connection on any of three hostnames on 2026-08-08. This is an infrastructure condition at the issuer, not a policy refusal, and it is not one this session can legitimately route around.
acquisitionDisposition.isThisAnIllegalBypassSituationDetail: There is nothing to bypass. No access control refused the request. The correct response is to retry later or use another authorized channel, not to find a different door.
acquisitionDisposition.reopenCondition: Closed by any successful retrieval of the two forms from courts.mt.gov, followed by a comparison against sha256 968f68c7…db003d and cb2fa9c3…747207.

sourceMaterializationEligibility.laterMaterializationPermittedDetail: Not on this record. Materializing an asset whose title is a filename stem, whose revision is unknown and whose currentness has never been confirmed against the issuer would carry all three defects into the runtime contract. Both assets additionally remain source_gated.
sourceMaterializationEligibility.additionalObstacle: Both assets are .docx. Whether a .docx source can be materialized and rendered at all in the current pipeline is an open question already recorded for the sibling Montana assets, and it sits behind the currentness gate rather than in front of it.
prerequisitesInOrder: 1. Retrieve Form A and Form B from courts.mt.gov when the host is reachable, or through another authorized channel.
2. Read the printed title and revision from each face and correct the edition's filename-stem titles.
3. Compare the retrieved bytes against sha256 968f68c7…db003d and cb2fa9c3…747207 to settle currentness.
4. Clear the source gate if the comparison holds.

implementationFamilyEffect.effectOfThisJob: This job is one of two open dependencies of rcap-mt-composed-route, which covers four Montana tracks; the other is the Montana in-repository reconciliation, which is complete and pushed. It does not release that job, because the currentness question it exists to close could not be closed. What it does contribute is a reconfirmed, precisely characterised block, a title defect the edition did not record, and an explicit statement that the queue's no_repository_binary is wrong on both rows.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Montana official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. Both assets stay source_gated with runtime disabled, currentness stays unconfirmed, the titles stay wrong, and no field map is built. No packet becomes generatable and no renderer is assigned.
implementationFamilyEffect.netEffectOnBlockers: One blocker is reconfirmed rather than cleared, one new defect is recorded, and one false blocker — the queue's no_repository_binary — is identified as wrong.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: the documents, the issuer and the adopting Supreme Court order are established and both assets are retained. It is not acquired: nothing was retrieved. It is not official_download_automation_blocked in the sense that family normally carries, because there is no automation block — there is no reachable server at all, which is a different condition with a different remedy. The stop condition directs stopping where revision is uncertain, and it is.

expectedDownstreamEffect: The Montana MMRTA source gate stays open, and the reason is now precisely characterised rather than assumed: the issuer's host does not resolve or accept a connection at all, which is a different condition from the HTTP 403 automation blocks recorded elsewhere and calls for a retry or another channel rather than a workaround. Two identities are confirmed with their issuer and adopting order, and their retained digests are recorded as edition provenance rather than misattributed to the issuer. A title defect the edition did not record — official_title carrying a filename stem on both rows — is surfaced with the correct value deliberately withheld until a face can be read. The queue's no_repository_binary is identified as wrong on both rows. No binary is acquired, no receipt is created, nothing enters version control, no component is rebound, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
